availability_limits: The obsolete /comission/department/deptexsec/trade_remedies/ URL did not open through web; the existing acquisition report independently recorded its HTTP failure.

The corroborated remedies portal returned its title through web but no extractable body. One bounded ordinary urllib request from this workspace returned HTTP 502. No portal API, internal route or current-measure table was guessed.
The public department document index includes decisions, investigation notices and draft reports, with publication/effective dates; it is not itself a verified current-duty register.
Specific current countervailing decisions and full safeguard applicability were not established in the bounded accessible navigation. This is an evidence gap, not evidence of no measures.
Pagination links were visible in the legal index, but tool navigation could not resolve them; older pages were not audited.
The opendata final landing had no extractable body in web. A corroborated landing replacement does not establish a VAT or OData source replacement.
